open_points.subject: context: clock-source integration
open_points.text: “one clock source is the only reader of both; every other part of the portal obtains time from it”
open_points.question: Which named module capabilities provide the wall and monotonic readings, and which flow owner calls each capability for operation timestamps, expiry checks, audit timestamps and viewer-entry rate limiting?
options: A clock-source module exposes separate wall-time and monotonic-reading capabilities called by each owning use case, the audit writer and the transport guard
The runtime reads the clocks and injects values into flow owners
Each owner receives an injected clock object and calls unnamed methods on it
open_points.default_guess: Add clock-source wall-time and monotonic-reading capabilities; have each owning use case call wall time once, the audit writer call wall time for occurred_at, and the transport guard call monotonic time once per viewer-entry request.

open_points.subject: context: snapshot import audit
open_points.text: “module:snapshot_import owns validation, fingerprint, replay classification, the import record and its audit” and “Every classified attempt inserts one fresh import record with a fresh import_id and one snapshot.import audit, committed together.”
open_points.question: Does import_snapshot call capability:audit_writer.append_audit for every classified attempt, including replay and conflict, or does snapshot_import create and append the audit through an operation of its own?
options: snapshot_import calls audit_writer.append_audit inside the import transaction
snapshot_import constructs and persists the audit itself
snapshot_import calls a separate snapshot-specific audit capability
open_points.default_guess: Have capability:snapshot_import.import_snapshot call capability:audit_writer.append_audit inside the same transaction for every classified attempt.
